title: Financial Statement Comparability and the Efficiency of Acquisition Decisions

models.sample_description: Completed U.S. SDC mergers, majority-interest acquisitions and asset acquisitions announced 1983–2009, with both bidder and target public; excludes repurchases, deals under $1 million, and deals smaller than 1 percent of bidder pre-acquisition market value; observations must have comparability, returns and required regression-control data. Table 3 model (1) has 1,307 acquisitions.
models.method_details: The Table 3 coefficient discussion explicitly attributes the coefficient interpretation to OLS-derived weights (footnote 21), supporting OLS as the underlying regression estimator. The robust-standard-error correction is separately recorded.
models.equation_text: ACQ_CAR_i = β0 + β1 TRG_COMPRNK_{i,t−1} + β2 ACQ_SIZE + β3 ACQ_LEV + β4 ACQ_TOBIN_DUM + β5 ACQ_ROA + β6 ACQ_FCF + β7 (ACQ_TOBIN_DUM × ACQ_FCF) + β8 TRG_SIZE + β9 TRG_LEV + β10 TRG_TOBIN + β11 TRG_ROA + β12 STOCK_CORR + β13 SYNC + β14 BLOCK + β15 ALL_CASH + β16 ALL_STOCK + β17 TENDER + β18 HOSTILE + β19 DIFFIND + β20 REL_SIZE + ε_i. Equation (5), expanded to the retained full-control Table 3 columns; ACQ_CAR_i is the model-specific dependent variable.

standard_errors.details: Table 3 reports “robust standard errors” but does not identify the robust correction or a cluster dimension.

evidence.quote: t -stats are based on robust standard errors.

preprocessing.description: Target TRG_COMP is ranked into deciles 0–9 and divided by 9 to produce TRG_COMPRNK on [0,1].

evidence.quote: we form decile ranks from zero to nine of the _TRG_COMP_ measure and then divide these ranked values by nine to form scaled-rank values that range from zero to one.
Target’s comparability ( _TRG_COMP_ ) is ranked into deciles and scaled between zero and one to form a scaled-rank value of comparability ( _TRG_COMPRNK_ ).

other.description: Table 3 reports two-tailed significance tests generally and one-tailed significance for the target-comparability coefficient.

evidence.quote:

dependent_variable.name: ACQ_CAR
dependent_variable.definition: Acquirer three-day cumulative abnormal return centered on announcement days −1 to +1. Abnormal returns use the market model with CRSP value-weighted returns; parameters are estimated over event days −205 to −6.
dependent_variable.formula: Three-day cumulative abnormal return over event days [−1,+1] using market-model returns; estimation window [−205,−6].

evidence.quote: We measure acquirer returns, _ACQ_CAR_, using three-day cumulative abnormal returns (CARs)

_ACQ_CAR_ Acquirer cumulative abnormal return measured over three days around the
acquisition announcement

independent_variables.name: TRG_COMPRNK
independent_variables.definition: Target firm financial statement comparability for t−1. Firm-pair comparability is the negative of the average absolute difference between predicted earnings from the two firm-specific accounting systems applied to the same target-firm returns; the target score averages this across all other firms in the same two-digit SIC industry. TRG_COMP is ranked into deciles 0–9 and divided by nine to form TRG_COMPRNK on [0,1].
independent_variables.formula: TRG_COMPRNK_{i,t−1} = DecileRank_{0..9}(TRG_COMP_{i,t−1}) / 9; TRG_COMP_{i,t−1} = mean_{j in same SIC2, j≠i}[-mean_t |E(Earnings^i_i,t) − E(Earnings^i_j,t)|].

evidence.quote:
COORDINATOR-VERIFIED MATHEMATICAL TRANSCRIPTION (Equations2-4 comparability construction, physical PDF page 18):
Equation(2): E(Earnings^i_i,t) = alpha_hat_i + beta_hat_i*Return_it. Equation(3): E(Earnings^i_j,t) = alpha_hat_j + beta_hat_j*Return_it. Both mappings apply firm i returns; superscript i denotes the return source, subscript denotes the accounting-system parameter source. Equation(4): CompAcct_ijt = (1/tau)*sum_t^tau abs(E(Earnings^i_i,t)-E(Earnings^i_j,t)). Absolute-value bars were checked in enlarged source crop. Following prose multiplies this average absolute difference by -1 so greater/less-negative values mean greater comparability, then averages pair scores across all other same-two-digit-SIC firms to construct TRG_COMP. Equations2-4 are deterministic uses of Equation1 estimated coefficients, not additional fitted regressions.

independent_variables.name: ACQ_SIZE
independent_variables.definition: Acquirer size, measured as the natural logarithm of acquirer market value at the end of the quarter before the announcement.
independent_variables.formula: ln(acquirer market value at prior-quarter end).

evidence.quote: _ACQ_SIZE_ Acquirer size. Measured as the natural logarithm of acquirer’s market value at the end of the quarter prior to the announcement

independent_variables.name: ACQ_LEV
independent_variables.definition: Acquirer pre-acquisition leverage: long-term plus short-term debt divided by total assets at fiscal year-end before the acquisition announcement.
independent_variables.formula: (long-term debt + short-term debt) / total assets, fiscal year-end before announcement.

evidence.quote: _ACQ_LEV_ Acquirer’s pre-acquisition leverage. Measured as the sum of long-term debt and short-term debt deflated by total assets at the fiscal year-end prior to an acquisition announcement

independent_variables.name: ACQ_TOBIN_DUM
independent_variables.definition: Indicator for acquirer Tobin’s Q relative to the sample median, with conflicting coding: the research-design text says 1 for Q below the median; the Appendix says 1 for Q above the median. Acquirer characteristics are measured at fiscal year-end before the announcement unless specified otherwise.

evidence.quote: ( _ACQ_TOBIN_DUM_ ) that is set to one when an acquirer’s Tobin’s Q is less than the median and zero otherwise
_ACQ_TOBIN_DUM_ Dummy variable that takes the value one if the acquirer’s Tobin’s Q is greater than the sample median, and zero otherwise

independent_variables.name: ACQ_ROA
independent_variables.definition: Acquirer ROA for the year ended before the announcement year, calculated as operating income before depreciation divided by average total assets.
independent_variables.formula: Operating income before depreciation / average total assets.

evidence.quote: _ACQ_ROA_ Acquirer return on assets for the year ended before the announcement year, measured as operating income before depreciation scaled by average total assets

independent_variables.name: ACQ_FCF
independent_variables.definition: Acquirer free cash flow: operating income before depreciation less interest expense, tax expense and dividends, scaled by total assets; acquirer characteristics are measured at the fiscal year-end before announcement unless otherwise specified.
independent_variables.formula: (operating income before depreciation − interest expense − tax expense − dividends) / total assets.

evidence.quote: _ACQ_FCF_ Acquirer’s free cash flow. Measured as operating income before depreciation minus interest expense, tax expense, and dividends, scaled by total assets
Both acquirer and target characteristics, unless specified otherwise, are measured at the end of the fiscal year prior to acquisition announcements.

independent_variables.name: ACQ_TOBIN_DUM×FCF
independent_variables.definition: Interaction of ACQ_TOBIN_DUM and ACQ_FCF. ACQ_FCF is operating income before depreciation less interest expense, tax expense, and dividends, scaled by total assets. ACQ_TOBIN_DUM is described as below-median in the research-design text but above-median in the Appendix.
independent_variables.formula: ACQ_TOBIN_DUM × ACQ_FCF.

evidence.quote: _ACQ_TOBIN_DUM×FCF_
an interaction between ACQ_ FCF and _ACQ_TOBIN_DUM_

evidence.quote: _TRG_SIZE_ Target’s size. Measured as the natural logarithm of acquirer’s market value at the end of the quarter prior to the announcement

independent_variables.name: TRG_LEV

evidence.quote: _TRG_LEV_ Target’s pre-acquisition leverage. Measured as the sum of long-term debt and shortterm debt deflated by total assets at the fiscal year-end prior to an acquisition announcement

independent_variables.name: TRG_TOBIN
independent_variables.definition: The Appendix labels this target Tobin’s Q but defines it as acquirer market value of assets divided by book value of assets at fiscal year-end before announcement; the target/acquirer subject mismatch is unresolved.

evidence.quote: _TRG_TOBIN_ Target’s pre-acquisition Tobin’s Q. Measured as the ratio of acquirer’s market value of assets to the book value of assets at the fiscal year-end prior to an acquisition announcement

independent_variables.name: TRG_ROA
independent_variables.definition: Target ROA for the year ended before announcement, measured as operating income before depreciation scaled by average total assets.
independent_variables.formula: Target operating income before depreciation / target average total assets.

evidence.quote: _TRG_ROA_ Target return on assets for the year ended before the announcement year, measured as operating income before depreciation scaled by average total assets

independent_variables.name: STOCK_CORR
independent_variables.definition: Target firm i’s average stock-return correlation with all other firms in the same 2-digit SIC industry, measured over the same 16 quarters used to estimate the firm-specific accounting system.
independent_variables.formula: Average correlation(Return_target, Return_other firms in same 2-digit SIC; 16 quarters).

evidence.quote: _STOCK_CORR_ Target firm i ’s average stock return correlation with all other firms in the same 2digit SIC code

independent_variables.name: SYNC
independent_variables.definition: Target stock-return synchronicity, measured as adjusted R² from a regression of daily stock return on daily market return over the same 16 quarters as the accounting-system estimation.
independent_variables.formula: Adjusted R² of the daily stock-return on daily market-return regression.

evidence.quote: SYNC Target’s stock return synchronicity. Measured as the adjusted R <sup>2</sup> from a regression of a firm’s daily stock return on the daily market return over the same 16 quarters that we use to estimate firm-specific accounting system

independent_variables.name: BLOCK
independent_variables.definition: Indicator equal to 1 if an institutional investor owns more than 5 percent of the target’s shares, and 0 otherwise.
independent_variables.formula: 1 if institutional ownership > 5%; 0 otherwise.

evidence.quote: BLOCK Dummy variable that takes the value one if an institutional investor owns more than 5 percent of the target’s shares, and zero otherwise

evidence.quote: _ALL_CASH_ Dummy variable that takes the value one if the acquisition was financed at least 90 percent by cash, and zero otherwise

independent_variables.name: ALL_STOCK
independent_variables.definition: Indicator equal to 1 if at least 90 percent of the acquisition was financed with acquirer stock, and 0 otherwise.
independent_variables.formula: 1 if acquirer-stock financing ≥ 90%; 0 otherwise.

evidence.quote: _ALL_STOCK_ Dummy variable that takes the value one if the acquisition was financed at least 90 percent by acquirer’s stocks, and zero otherwise

independent_variables.definition: Indicator equal to 1 when SDC classifies the acquisition as a tender offer, and 0 otherwise.
independent_variables.formula: 1 if SDC tender offer; 0 otherwise.

evidence.quote: TENDER Dummy variable that takes the value one if the acquisition is classified as a tender offer by SDC, and zero otherwise

independent_variables.definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the acquisition was achieved through a hostile takeover, and 0 otherwise.

evidence.quote: HOSTILE Dummy variable that takes the value one if the acquisition was achieved through a hostile takeover, and zero otherwise

independent_variables.definition: Indicator equal to 1 if acquirer and target differ in 2-digit SIC industry, and 0 otherwise.

independent_variables.definition: Relative deal size, measured as transaction value divided by bidder market value.

sample_extraction.data_section_full_text:
We use the SDC Mergers and Acquisitions database, beginning with all U.S. mergers and acquisitions


with announcement dates between January 1, 1983, and December 31, 2009. <sup>19</sup> Panel A of Table 1 summarizes


our sample selection procedure. We begin with all completed deals identified by SDC as mergers (M),


acquisitions of majority interest (AM), or acquisitions of assets (AA). We identify all deals where both bidder


and target are public firms and exclude repurchases. This process gives us 6,282 mergers and acquisitions from


the SDC database. Next, to ensure the deals we examine are material, we eliminate acquisitions with a deal


value less than $1 million and acquisitions that are less than 1 percent of the acquirer’s pre-acquisition market


value (e.g., Moeller et al. 2004; McNichols and Stubben 2015). <sup>20</sup> Finally, we exclude observations that lack the


data required to calculate the comparability measure, acquirers’ and targets’ announcement returns, and control


variables included in our regression models. This yields a final sample of 1,307 acquisitions.
